purpose: Audit signed squared sine higher partials and identify stereo-midpoint cancellation using exact retained waveform windows/frequencies. No new frequency/window/parameter search; no model fitting or promotion gate.
estimator: Twelve sine/cosine harmonic pairs plus DC, fixed prior fundamental, Hann-weighted ordinary least squares (weights apply to basis and signal). L/R/mid/side separately; full original window and three equal thirds. Absolute phases refer to first sample of each window; report amplitudes, relative dB, complex ratio/phase and fit residual.
native_probe: Actual shipping wave() in unchanged Engine.cpp via translation-unit include. One-second stationary carrier table1 at exact source frequency through engine with outputCircuit false/true, tone0, chorus0, drive0, limiterfalse, dcBlockfalse, clock0; analyze last350ms. Additional 65536-phase coherent direct wave1 identity/DC/PM algebra checks, no hardware equivalence claim.
math: Signed square sine odd-harmonic coefficients b_n=-8/(pi*n*(n*n-4)) for positive odd n; b_even=0; DC0. Reference higher harmonics never fitted from capture.
limits: Manual note gates, source effect/capture state and response unknown.
No exact-ROM, bit-depth, arithmetic-width, native-clock or DAC inference.
No production code edits; no audio rerender beyond two short native stationary controls.
No novel physical constants or artificial noise.
